limitations: Only the ordinary independence complex of the standard five-regular Clebsch graph and its full rational degree-three homology action are classified. No integral module lattice, equivariant homotopy splitting or higher-dimensional family is claimed. Publication priority remains provisional.
scientific_integrity: The reported theorem is a rational automorphism-module decomposition, not an independently validated publication. Its prerequisite integral homotopy classification is reproduced exactly but not claimed as new.
title: Complete rational symmetry of the Clebsch independence complex
